name: 60-inch mixology cocktail station with 10-circuit cold plate
region: US standard Signature underbar configuration; inch dimensions
note: Complete passive cocktail/mixology station with 10-circuit ice-cooled cold plate; no powered chiller, soda gun or external beverage supply system included. Hot/cold backsplash faucet accepts 3/8 inch sink leads; dipper and rinser accept 3/8 inch cold leads. Rinser 1.2 gpm with included 30 psi regulator; install regulator and external backflow prevention because rinser lacks a 1-inch air gap; separate shutoff recommended. Full assembly is 24 inches deep including speed rail; highest overall envelope 37 inches, work surface 30 inches and soda housing 34 inches. Standard bullet feet at drawing nominal position; adjustment adds height. Lift-off garnish and sliding ice covers require access. No elixir bottle well on this model. Thread legs fully into sockets and level with bullet feet. Remove exposed Signature cam locks unless sealed against a wall; align and seal field joints with approved sealant. Install drains to applicable plumbing requirements. Maintain operational, cleaning and connection access; manufacturer gives no numerical installation clearances.
